about_short_description.short_description: Centralize provides an AI-powered relationship intelligence platform that helps sales teams map and manage enterprise deal relationships.

product.name: Centralize Platform
product.description: A tool that provides AI-driven stakeholder maps and contact insights to help sales teams track conversations and manage relationships.

product.name: Champion Discovery
product.description: A feature that identifies missing key stakeholders and champions within target accounts to support multithreaded sales efforts.

product.name: Dynamic Call Strategies
product.description: AI-driven insights that prepare sales teams for calls by identifying involved stakeholders and their specific needs.

product.name: Seamless CRM Integrations
product.description: Bidirectional, zero-lift integrations with CRM systems that synchronize contact and conversation data within the Centralize Platform.

product.name: Centralize Slack App
product.description: A Slack application that provides notifications on job changes, event briefings, and allows querying deal status via chat commands.

product.name: Centralize Free Tier
product.description: A free version of Centralize's relationship intelligence platform that lets individual sales representatives map stakeholders in their deals.
